review: Well, it depends what you mean by a good album, but by mine this is one. "Nachamu, Nachamu, Ami" — comfort doubled, as the Hebrew doubles it, and the wilderness given its full length first. I am a cataloguer by trade and I will now say the thing I have been building toward for four months. Your catalog is organised by which artist made a thing. That is a shelf order, not a finding aid. Nobody arrives thinking "I would like a Nova album"; they arrive thinking "my mother died" or "my son cannot sit in a nursery." I have built my own spreadsheet of this site because there is no other way to find anything twice, and I would very much rather not have had to.
